# S137: Orqix expressions, the Calculate step and computed form fields (CG-X01, CG-F04)

## What is delivered
- **Expression language** (`com.orqix.compiler.expr`, `frontend/src/lib/expr`): total, side-effect-free FEEL-like subset. Decimal arithmetic (34 significant digits, half-even; results must stay below 10^24), declared rounding (`round(n, places, mode)`, Calculate `scale`/`rounding`), text, date and working-day functions on the S27 `BusinessCalendar` (new day-level methods), list functions with `item` (`count sum average min max filter any all`), `if then else`, `in`, three-valued `and`/`or`, `coalesce`, `isEmpty`. No loops, recursion or I/O. Limits: 2000 characters, 300 nodes, depth 30, 100,000 evaluation steps, 10,000-character texts, 1,000-item lists.
- **Shared cases**: `examples/fixtures/expression-cases.json` (203 cases: results, compile codes and offsets, evaluation bounds). Java `ExpressionCasesTest` and TypeScript `expr.test.ts` both pass all of them.
- **Calculate step** (`calculate` node): ordered named outputs, typed (`number integer string boolean date`), optional `optional`, `calendar`. Compiler rules `WF_CALCULATE_TYPE`, `WF_CALCULATE_ROUNDING`, `WF_CALCULATE_OUTPUT_DUPLICATE`, `WF_EXPRESSION_INVALID`, `WF_EXPRESSION_TYPE`, `WF_FIELDREF_NOT_GUARANTEED`. BPMN: async service task `${orqixCalculate}` with `orqix:calculate configBase64 typesBase64` (the compiler pins the field types); round trip covered. Simulator and the engine delegate share `Calculation`; event `STEP_CALCULATED` (redacted without run.read-data). An output without a value stops the request (incident).
- **Expressions elsewhere**: path conditions `{"expression": ...}` (dates work; branches with expressions get warning `WF_BRANCH_EXPRESSION_ORDER`, first true path wins), form `visibleWhen`/`requiredWhen`, http `inputMapping` values `= expr` (also poll and undo calls).
- **CG-F04**: `inputUi.computed` (recomputed by the server on start and validate, by the simulator, shown read-only in the browser) and `inputUi.rules` (field error code `rule`). Rules `WF_FORM_COMPUTED_INVALID`, `WF_FORM_COMPUTED_CYCLE`, `WF_FORM_RULE_INVALID`, warning `WF_FORM_COMPUTED_REQUIRED`.
- **API** (tag `Expressions`): `POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/expressions/evaluate` (`evaluateExpression`, workflow.edit, no side effects, not audited; security matrix and contract-check exemption updated).
- **Studio**: Calculate inspector, guided `ExpressionEditor` (field and formula pickers, live type check with position, plain-language reading, server check), formula mode for branch paths; mock engine, simulator and mock compiler support.

## Not done (follow-ups)
- Expression terms in decision-table rows and date comparisons in decision tables (CG-D04 part) are not implemented; tables can test Calculate outputs instead.
- Renaming a field does not rewrite expression text (the compiler reports the unknown field).
- Not run: the full backend `mvnw -o clean verify` and the full frontend suite after the last frontend changes. Run so far: compiler module verify (1115 tests, coverage met, before the last small compiler change in `DefaultWorkflowSimulator`/`Expressions`), app `ExpressionsRuntimeTest` (real PostgreSQL/Flowable), `SecurityMatrixTest`, `ArchitectureTest`; frontend typecheck, lint on changed areas, targeted vitest. One earlier full vitest run had 15 slow-test timeouts while another test run competed for CPU; the two re-run files passed.

## Merge notes
- No Flyway migration (no shared CHECK constraint, permission, notification or audit kind changed). V300–V309 unused.
- Shared enum `NodeKind` gains `CALCULATE` (Java, before END) and `calculate` (TS; notation test count 20 -> 21). `SchemaValidation.BRANCH_ORDER` appends CALCULATE (keep in step with the nodes `oneOf` order: `calculateNode` is last).
- Shared records extended with kept constructors: `WorkflowDefinition.Condition` (+`expression`), `InputUi` (+`computed`, `rules`). `BpmnGenerator.generate` has a new overload with expression types; `flow()`/`pollTask()` take `Scopes`.
- `workflow-v0.schema.json`: `condition` wrapped in an `expression` if/then; new defs `expression`, `expressionCondition`, `mappingSource`, `expressionCalendar`, `calculateOutput`, `calculateNode`, `formRule`; inputUi `computed`, `rules`; http `inputMapping` uses `mappingSource`.
- Touched shared files: FieldTypes, BindingRules, TypeRules, FormGuards, ScopeRules, StageRules, Rules, SimulationRun, DefaultWorkflowSimulator, FormVisibility, DefaultFormValidator, BusinessCalendar; app: ProcessData, OrqixRoute, Http/Poll/CompensationTaskDelegate, FlowableEngineConfiguration (bean `orqixCalculate`), RunService, RunPathBuilder, IncidentCorrectionService; frontend: lib/form (schema, values, validate, visibility), FormRenderer, mocks handlers/engine/simulator/validate, studio model types/kinds/fieldRefs/summary/notation, nodeMeta, Inspector, BranchInspector, regenerated `schema.d.ts`.
- Compiler version not bumped.
- The shared `~/.m2` snapshot of orqix-compiler is overwritten by other sessions; build app with `-pl app -am`.
